title: QR code renderer in a TrueType font
claim: Show HN: QR code renderer in a TrueType font
why_good: Renders QR codes purely via a TrueType font — a delightfully clever hack, but a novelty, not a product.
value: No business; it's an ingenious trick people share, not buy.
